source_record.description:
HEY THERE

You've spent the last few years as the analyst sitting alongside a mobile squad—close to the tracking, the experiments and the numbers behind their decisions. You've also been leading a small team as well for a while now, and you don't want to give up either half.

Good, because this role doesn't ask you to. You'll lead our squad analysts, and you'll also be the hands-on analyst for Monetization. Roughly half your week in each role, at least at the start. Stepping up to lead here doesn't mean handing the interesting work to someone else.

You'll be building solid data products, helping our Monetization team optimize conversion and revenue, but you'll also be responsible for ensuring that our product and engineering teams own the quality of the data they produce. Building this culture is a big part of what we're hiring for.

Let's shape the future of nutrition together and make Yazio the most successful nutrition app worldwide!

This role is 100% remote and open to candidates based in Germany, Spain, Portugal or the UK.

YOUR MISSION

Our product generates billions of data points every month, and our development teams run hundreds of experiments a year. In your first year, you'll:

  • Lead a small team of analysts embedded in our product squads. They're the ones measuring the impact of what engineering builds and helping figure out what comes next

  • Be the analyst for Monetization yourself. You’ll handle tracking for new features, the experiments behind our conversion funnels and the reporting the squad runs on

  • Set the example for how the work gets done. You'll write less production code than the analysts in your team, and the way you solve problems is what they'll pick up

  • Set the data quality bar: what gets tested when data comes in, what gets tested once it's transformed, what gets tested in the reporting layer and what anomaly detection catches before a stakeholder spots it

  • Move that responsibility upstream to the teams producing the data. Expect pushback from people who haven't had to think about it before

  • Own the path from raw event data to curated, ready-to-use datasets in our self-service BI tool

  • Take on the strategy side of squad analytics: how PMs and engineering managers use data when they make decisions

YOUR PROFILE

You'll feel at home here if:

  • You've been the analyst inside a mobile product squad. Event tracking, funnel and user journey analysis, experiments. You plan around release cycles and handle old app versions as a matter of course

  • You've managed analysts without stepping away from the work yourself

  • Experimentation is where you're strongest. You’ve run plenty of A/B tests, and you can talk through bandits, quasi-experiments and where Bayesian and frequentist approaches part ways

  • You've built a data quality regime. You've held a number back because it didn't reconcile, then gone and fixed whatever let it through

  • You write SQL all day and Python when you need it, and dbt is how you transform data

  • When you take an analysis to a PM, it comes with what you'd do next. And when a number turns out to be wrong, you say so and change the process that produced it

Bonus points for:

  • Experience with subscription businesses, including the mobile gateway SDKs (App Store, Google Play)

  • A strong statistics background

  • Dagster or Airflow for scheduling

  • Data catalogues like DataHub

 

OUR CORE TECH STACK

Here's what we run in production:

  • Warehouse: Snowflake

  • Transformation & orchestration: dbt, Dagster

  • Experimentation: GrowthBook

  • Self-service analytics: Omni

  • ML workflows: Prefect

  • GenAI: Claude

If you've worked with a cloud warehouse, dbt and an experimentation platform in some form, the patterns transfer. AI is part of how we work here: writing and checking code, summarizing data and keeping documentation current. We'd want you to be critical about what it gives back.

WHY US?

  • An exciting product with millions of users in over 150 countries, driven by our mission to transform the world through healthy eating

  • A remote-first setup: work 100% from home, join a co-working space, or work abroad for several weeks per year

  • 30 vacation days to relax and recharge, plus 5 child sick days if your little one needs you

  • A focus-driven culture that values efficiency over long hours - no overtime expectations, and if it happens, you get that time back!

  • A high-impact environment where your work drives real change - short decision-making processes and no micromanagement

  • A team culture where ambition and balance go hand in hand, supported by strong connections - from our fully covered company retreat to team meetups and virtual coffee breaks

  • Tools and support to do your best work: MacBook, monitor, and €1,000 annual learning budget, plus regular feedback and career development

  • A truly international team with English as our company language and a shared commitment to growth and well-being - supported by Sunday Supplements and Nilo Health

DIVERSITY AND INCLUSION

At Yazio, we believe that diversity fuels innovation. We are committed to fostering an inclusive environment where everyone, regardless of gender identity, race, religion, age, sexual orientation, or ability, feels valued and empowered. We celebrate different perspectives and actively encourage individuals from all backgrounds to apply.

READY TO JOIN US?

Excited to take YAZIO to the next level and help people worldwide lead healthier lives? We’d love to hear from you! Please send us:

  • Your CV in English

  • Any additional materials that showcase your work (e.g., LinkedIn profile, portfolio)

Your Role

As a Staff Frontend Engineer at bunch, you will shape the architecture, quality, and developer experience of the product surfaces our customers and internal teams rely on every day. You will work across product teams to make our frontend systems scalable, reliable, accessible, and fast — while helping engineers ship with clarity and confidence.

This is not only a delivery role. Your decisions will influence how frontend engineering at bunch evolves: the standards we adopt, the patterns we reuse, the quality bar we hold, and the way product, design, and engineering collaborate to build excellent user experiences.

How the role contributes to our vision

bunch is building the backbone of private markets, combining exceptional expertise, operational excellence, and frictionless technology. Our platform enables funds and private investors to seamlessly and securely set up and manage their investment entities.

As a Staff Frontend Engineer, you will play a pivotal role in turning complex workflows into intuitive, robust, and scalable product experiences. You will help ensure our frontend foundation enables rapid delivery across teams while maintaining high standards for usability, performance, accessibility, and maintainability.

Top priorities

  1. Lead our migration from Svelte to React. Hold the architectural picture across both stacks, sequence the work against product delivery, and land it without stalling teams.

  2. Maintain and evolve our design system, together with the frontend guild, so product teams ship consistent, accessible UI faster.

  3. Support and guide frontend initiatives across teams, with the frontend guild — application architecture, performance, testing strategy, developer experience, and technical debt reduction — from diagnosis through measurable delivery.

  4. Be the bar raiser for UX and UI quality, raising the standard through design reviews, reusable patterns, mentoring, and thoughtful technical writing.

  5. Advance how we build with AI — find where agentic tooling genuinely improves engineering practice, and shape the codebase (module boundaries, API contracts, documentation) so it works well for people and agents alike.

Your first 90 days

  • 30 days: map the frontend architecture, product domains, design system, team workflows, and the main bottlenecks affecting delivery and quality.

  • 60 days: publish a structured problem analysis and proposal for one cross-team frontend initiative with clear trade-offs, stakeholders, and success measures.

  • 90 days: lead a systemic improvement from kickoff to measurable progress across teams, while helping Senior Engineers grow through collaboration, reviews, and shared ownership.

About you

  • Track record — You have already operated at Staff scope, with or without the title, and have shipped systemic frontend or product-engineering improvements across multiple teams. People listen to you because of what you have delivered, how clearly you think, and how effectively you collaborate.

  • Frontend craft — Deep expertise in modern frontend engineering, with strong command of TypeScript, component architecture, state management, design systems, accessibility, performance, testing, and maintainable application architecture.

  • AI-native practice — You use AI coding tools daily and have gone past autocomplete into agentic workflows. You have a considered view on where they genuinely help, where they don't, and what a codebase needs to be a good place to work in with agents.

  • Product judgment — You care about the user experience as much as the technical solution. You can translate ambiguous workflows and business constraints into pragmatic, elegant product experiences.

  • Systems thinking — You are comfortable reasoning across frontend, backend, APIs, infrastructure, observability, security, and compliance when the problem requires it.

  • Operating style — You think in quarters and years, not only sprints. You drive cross-team change through credibility, clear writing, architectural reasoning, and strong stakeholder alignment — not through authority.

  • Collaborative Leadership: A proactive relationship-builder who can set technical direction and influence without formal authority, manage diverse stakeholders and build alignment on difficult technical decisions, while mentoring engineers.

  • Language — Fluent English, written and spoken. You can make complex technical decisions legible to engineers, product partners, design partners, and leadership alike.

Our tech stack

  • Frontend: TypeScript, React, Svelte — we are consolidating on React, and this role leads that migration.

  • Backend: TypeScript, Node.js, Nest.js

  • Database: MySQL

  • Infrastructure: Kubernetes on AWS

  • Source Control & CI/CD: GitHub

  • Authentication: FusionAuth, Okta

  • Internal Tools: Retool

  • Messaging: Twilio, SendGrid

  • Forms: Tally

Workplace & Benefits

  • Customizable benefits package covering wellbeing, sport, mobility, food, and more

  • 28 days of vacation, plus 2 company days and local public holidays

  • Remote-flexible hybrid setup

  • Up to 6 remote calendar weeks a year

  • A great tech and work setup

  • Work with a diverse team of 130+ bunchies from 40+ countries, with leaders who are best-in-class in their domains

Hiring process

  1. Initial screening with Talent Acquisition (30 min): get acquainted with bunch, explore your motivation, and understand whether what we offer matches what you are looking for.

  2. Hiring Manager call — Engineering (60 min): a conversation with Engineering leadership focused on your scope, frontend leadership, product-engineering mindset, and how you diagnose and lead systemic improvements.

  3. Technical Interview (60 min): a hands-on technical conversation focused on frontend engineering craft, TypeScript, component design, maintainability, testing, and pragmatic problem-solving.

  4. Technical Interview — System Design (60 min): a frontend/system design conversation focused on architecture, data flow, performance, accessibility, reliability, and trade-offs in complex product systems.

  5. VP Product conversation (45 min): a cross-functional conversation focused on product thinking, customer empathy, business acumen, and how you partner with Product and Design on ambiguous problems.

  6. Final round (45 min): a closing conversation to align on what we heard across the process, answer remaining questions, and discuss expectations for the role and trial period.

About bunch

bunch is building the operating infrastructure for the next generation of private markets. We combine AI-powered automation with deep regulatory expertise to replace fragmented spreadsheets and manual processes with one integrated platform across the fund lifecycle, purpose-built for private markets heading toward $32 trillion in Assets Under Management.

We've 4x our ARR in 2025, crossed 150 fund managers and 12,000 LPs on the platform, and just closed our $35M Series B in May 2026. We're looking for ambitious people who want real ownership of hard problems, and who care about building infrastructure that actually matters to the people using it.

We process personal data in line with applicable laws (including GDPR). See our Privacy Policy for details on your rights and how to reach us.

source_record.description:
bunch is building the backbone of private markets. We are enabling next-gen fund operations with one integrated system that combines secure data infrastructure, AI-powered workflows and expert fund services. If you value ownership, growth through real responsibility, and working with a thoughtful, ambitious team, this role might be for you.

Your Role

  • This role is key to supporting bunch's growth going forward. You will establish and execute our commercial strategy with Enterprise customers, including larger VC funds, leading to bunch becoming the industry standard for private market investments.

  • A successful hire will contribute to setting our Commercial strategy at pace. You will play a key role in building further market knowledge and relations with potential VC customers, supporting bunch during a pivotal time.

Top responsibilities

  • Acquire new Enterprise customers across our markets (inbound and outbound).

  • Co-build a commercial acquisition strategy for new customer segments, mostly large Venture Capital funds.

  • Build and maintain relationships between bunch and i) General Partners (GPs) / CFOs / COOs of prospect and client funds, and ii) Angel investors.

  • Understand the pain points faced by prospects and customers to develop account plans for specific lists of target accounts, including demand generation and closing plans.

  • Stay informed about the competitive landscape to create winning proposals and pricing strategies.

  • Collaborate with the Strategy, Marketing, and Customer Success teams to develop best practices for generating demand and increasing customer engagement within the target accounts.

  • Create business cases that demonstrate the business value and return on investment clients can expect by using bunch.

  • Nurture client relationships, strive for process excellence that allows us to maximise customer satisfaction and ensure long-term retention.

About You

  • 3+ years of experience as an Account Executive or in a commercial role, ideally within the private investment market.

  • A local network of Fund Managers is a strong differentiator.

  • Excellent relationship-building and communication skills that enable you to gain trust through authenticity, expertise, and rapport-building.

  • A results-oriented, impact-driven mindset: you're curious to understand the broader context and expected outcomes, and you approach tasks with an entrepreneurial spirit to get things done.

  • Customer-centricity: you proactively understand and champion our customers' goals, always striving to provide value and align with their objectives.

  • Operational excellence in SaaS sales: you're skilled in optimising the sales process, analysing conversion rates, managing end-to-end sales funnels, and ensuring pipeline efficiency.

  • Business-level fluency in English.

Workplace and Benefits

  • Customisable benefits package covering wellbeing, sport, mobility, food, and more

  • 28 days of vacation, plus 2 company days and local public holidays

  • Up to 6 remote calendar weeks a year

  • A great tech and work setup

  • Work with a diverse team of 130+ bunchies from 40+ countries, with leaders who are best-in-class in their domains

What your interview journey will look like

  • Initial call with the People team (30 min) to get to know more about the role

  • Deep Dive with a Team member (30 min) for us to learn more about your ways of working

  • Case Study Interview with the team (60 min) for us to get a sense of how you approach Sales

  • Optional Meet & Greet: Meeting our Stakeholders at bunch Offices (2 x 30min)

About bunch

bunch is building the operating infrastructure for the next generation of private markets. We combine AI-powered automation with deep regulatory expertise to replace fragmented spreadsheets and manual processes with one integrated platform across the fund lifecycle, purpose-built for private markets heading toward $32 trillion in Assets Under Management.

We've 4x our ARR in 2025, crossed 150 fund managers and 12,000 LPs on the platform, and just closed our $35M Series B in May 2026. We're looking for ambitious people who want real ownership of hard problems, and who care about building infrastructure that actually matters to the people using it.


____

At bunch, we're committed to an inclusive environment where diversity is valued and celebrated. We provide equal opportunities to all qualified applicants.

We process personal data in line with applicable laws (including GDPR). See our Privacy Policy for details on your rights and how to reach us.

Firmenprofil

Unser Mandant ist ein erfolgreiches und etabliertes Bauunternehmen mit langjähriger Erfahrung im Ingenieurbau und realisiert anspruchsvolle Infrastrukturprojekte. Das Unternehmen steht für Qualität, Innovation und nachhaltige Bauweise und überzeugt durch eine moderne Unternehmenskultur sowie langfristige Entwicklungsperspektiven. Aufgrund der sehr guten Auftragslage suchen wir für unseren Mandanten einen Senior Bauleiter Ingenieurbau (m/w/d). Sie betreuen Projekte wohnortnah an Ihrem jeweiligen Einsatzstandort und übernehmen dabei verantwortungsvolle Bauvorhaben mit großem Gestaltungsspielraum.


Ihre Aufgaben

  • Eigenverantwortliche Leitung anspruchsvoller Ingenieurbauprojekte von der Arbeitsvorbereitung bis zur erfolgreichen Fertigstellung
  • Steuerung und Koordination von Nachunternehmern, Lieferanten sowie den internen Baustellenteams
  • Verantwortung für die Einhaltung von Kosten-, Termin- und Qualitätsvorgaben
  • Ansprechpartner für Bauherren, Planungsbüros und weitere Projektbeteiligte während der gesamten Bauphase
  • Durchführung des Nachtragsmanagements sowie Sicherstellung einer vollständigen Baustellendokumentation


Ihr Profil

  • Erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Studium im Bauingenieurwesen oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation
  • Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung als Bauleiter im Ingenieurbau
  • Fundierte Kenntnisse der VOB sowie im Bauvertrags- und Nachtragsmanagement
  • Ausgeprägte Führungs- und Organisationskompetenz sowie unternehmerisches Denken
  • Selbstständige, strukturierte und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise


Benefits

  • Unbefristete Festanstellung in einem wirtschaftlich erfolgreichen Bauunternehmen
  • Verantwortungsvolle Großprojekte im Ingenieurbau mit langfristiger Perspektive
  • Attraktive Vergütung inklusive zusätzlicher Sozialleistungen
  • Dienstwagen zur privaten Nutzung
  • Individuelle Weiterbildungs- und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten
  • Moderne Arbeitsmittel und digitalisierte Bauprozesse


Kontakt

Haben wir Ihr Interesse geweckt? Dann freuen wir uns auf Ihre Bewerbung mit Angabe Ihres frühestmöglichen Eintrittstermins und Ihrer Gehaltsvorstellung. Nach Eingang Ihrer Unterlagen setzen wir uns zeitnah mit Ihnen in Verbindung und besprechen gemeinsam die weiteren Schritte im Bewerbungsprozess. Selbstverständlich behandeln wir Ihre Bewerbung während des gesamten Prozesses vertraulich.

The will work on assigned programs with the respective Global Regulatory Portfolio Lead, Global Regulatory Lead and cross-functional team to lead the EU regulatory strategy and facilitate submission of data packages to the EMA. The role is responsible for planning and coordinating all aspects of regulatory submissions necessary to support product development, clinical trials and product registration. The role will represent RA on multidisciplinary product development subteams and Global Regulatory Team. Additional responsibilities include involvement in the writing and oversight of regulatory submissions, coordinating all aspects of paper and electronic regulatory submissions, proactively keeping updated on EU regulatory requirements, and interpreting regulatory intelligence for the internal teams. Summary of Key Responsibilities Serve as EU Regional Lead for assigned program (s); additional responsibilities may include serving as as Regulatory Program Lead (leading the Global Regulatory Team), for one of the early programs in the Alnylam pipeline. Work with the Global Regulatory Lead and Regulatory Affairs management to lead and define regulatory strategy and to compile and submit, in a timely manner, regulatory documents according to regulatory requirements and lead EU HA interactions. Regulatory documents may include the relevant forms, meeting requests, Briefing Documents for HA meetings, new Clinical Trial Applications (CTAs), Marketing Applications, Paediatric Plans, Orphan Designation and Expedited Pathway Applications (e.g. PRIME), and any amendments. Develop detailed regulatory strategy and project plans and support regulatory activities relating to specific portfolio of products/projects. Serve as member of the Global Regulatory Team, may serve as Regulatory representative in multidisciplinary product subteams or core team for assigned programs and participate as an active team member to provide strategic regulatory advice in relation to EU regulatory activities. Coordinate responses to regulatory authorities’ questions with strict adherence to deadlines. Serve as a liaison within internal departments at Alnylam, with CROs and with regulatory program managers at HAs. Maintain regulatory files in a format consistent with internal requirements. Facilitate as necessary the review of technical regulatory documentation and recommend changes to documentation or processes, including SOPs for regulatory compliance. Provide EU specific regulatory intelligence to internal stakeholders as appropriate. Qualifications Bachelor's degree with 6 or more years of experience in a Regulatory Affairs role; minimum of 8 years’ experience working in the biotech or pharmaceutical industry. Higher degree would be a plus. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including negotiation and influencing skills. Solid understanding of regulations and experience in interpretation of guidelines. Ability to think strategically and to proactively identify issues and mitigation strategies in various aspects of the drug development process. Experience with regulatory filings, including electronic submissions, e.g., CTAs, post-marketing variations, safety reporting, paediatric plans, PRIME etc. MAA filing and Type II variation experience is preferred. Excellent organizational and project management skills; demonstrated ability to prioritize multiple projects. Ability to work in a team environment, possessing interpersonal skills to work effectively with other departments at various levels and with CROs and external consultants. Technical system skills (e.g. word processing, spreadsheets, databases, online research) including submission-ready formatting. About WPP Production

We are WPP Production - the unified global production company that brings together all of WPP's content producers, studios and craft experts into one connected organisation. We combine world-class human craft with next generation technology to originate, design, and deliver multi-channel content systems at scale. Built for borderless collaboration and powered by deep craft expertise, we are the production engine designed for today's always on, AI driven marketing world.

About WPP

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world's leading brands. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit WPP.com.

A Hybrid working model

We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we've adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.

 

What does a Senior New Business Manager do at WPP Production?

The role

The Senior New Business Manager plays a critical role in driving growth for WPP Production, leading complex, high-value opportunities end-to-end and shaping how we respond to and win new business.

This is a strategic and creative role, responsible for defining the narrative, positioning and overall solution behind each pitch. You will take ownership of how we translate client challenges into clear, differentiated and commercially compelling responses.

Working closely with senior stakeholders across WPP Production and the wider WPP network, you will lead the development of integrated proposals — bringing together strategy, operations, creative and production into a single, cohesive story.

You will also help shape the strategic approach for each opportunity, ensuring the structure, messaging and positioning reflect WPP Production's proposition and competitive advantage. You will balance creative thinking with commercial understanding — clearly articulating how our operating models work, why they are effective, and the value they deliver for clients.

This is an opportunity to work on some of the most exciting and complex opportunities in the industry, with real influence over how we position ourselves and how we win.

 

Key areas of responsibility

  • Lead and own high-value opportunities end-to-end, from initial brief through to submission and presentation
  • Define the pitch narrative, positioning and "red thread", ensuring a clear, compelling & cohesive story throughout
  • Design and articulate client solutions, including operating models and value propositions, clearly demonstrating how they work and the value they deliver
  • Translate complex inputs into clear, structured and persuasive client-facing responses
  • Lead the development of high impact written content, including pitch decks, RFI/RFP responses and presentations, owning the narrative across all content
  • Present and support client-facing sessions, including credentials presentations and pitch meetings
  • Lead and align senior stakeholders around a single, cohesive response
  • Build strong relationships with key stakeholders across WPP Production, WPP OpCos and partners, enabling effective collaboration across opportunities
  • Ensure all outputs are strategically strong, consistent and clearly differentiated
  • Collaborate across WPP agencies on integrated, multi-disciplinary opportunities
  • Contribute to and help shape commercial strategy, including pricing narrative and value framing

 

  • Monitor competitor activity and industry trends to ensure WPP Production's positioning remains competitive
  • Identify opportunities to improve & drive innovation in how we approach, structure and deliver pitches
  • Mentor and support New Business Managers and Executives, raising standards across the team

 

What good looks like (key requirements)

  • 7+ years' experience in a new business or client growth roles within a creative, production or agency environment
  • Exceptional writing and storytelling skills, with the ability to shape clear, persuasive narratives from complex inputs
  • Strong strategic thinking, able to translate client challenges into structured, compelling solutions and responses
  • Proven experience leading complex pitch or proposal processes end-to-end
  • Confident communicator, with experience presenting to and influencing senior stakeholders
  • Highly organised, with the ability to manage multiple high-value opportunities and large volumes of content simultaneously
  • Strong commercial capability, with experience shaping proposals and contributing to pricing approach, value framing and commercial models
  • Proactive and solutions-oriented, with a strong sense of ownership and a drive to identify opportunities and deliver outcomes
  • Collaborative in approach, able to bring together multiple stakeholders and disciplines into a single aligned response
  • Strong understanding of the advertising production landscape and broader marketing ecosystem
  • Curious and engaged, with an interest in innovation and the evolving content and production landscape
  • Strong working knowledge of PowerPoint, Word and Excel, with a good eye for structure and presentation

 

#LI - HYBRID 

#LI - RH1

 

Why work here: 
At WPP Production, you'll help shape the future of content production at a truly global scale. We bring together world-class talent, cutting-edge studios, and advanced technology to solve some of the most complex creative and production challenges in the industry. You'll work in a collaborative, borderless environment where craft excellence is valued, innovation is encouraged, and AI and next-generation tools are used to amplify not replace human creativity. With access to diverse projects, global career opportunities, and the backing of WPP's unmatched network, this is a place where you can grow your skills, make real impact, and create work that performs for every audience, across every channel, at every moment.

Inclusion and Impact 
WPP is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to particular characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.

Our Engineering teams tackle complex technical challenges across a global, three-sided marketplace, building and scaling systems that serve millions of customers, riders and partners every day.

From real-time logistics to resilient infrastructure and marketplace optimisation, we design, build and operate technology that powers Deliveroo's growth at scale.

We're looking for a Senior Software Engineer, Proactive Security to join our London (Hybrid) team. In this role, you will be a part of our inclusive, collaborative global team responsible for enabling proactive security outcomes with "security paved paths" to ensure a safe, reliable and resilient delivery network.

Get to know our Proactive Security Engineering team — what drives us, how we work, and what you can expect.

 

About the Team

At Deliveroo we're striving to build London's best and most admired Security Engineering organisation as part of our global team based across North America and Europe.

Our London based Security Engineering team is looking for a Software Engineer to lead the design, development and operation of security services within Deliveroo's Product and Cloud Security domains. You will be a part of our inclusive, collaborative global team responsible for building "security paved paths" to ensure a safe, reliable and resilient delivery network.

This is a London based position reporting directly to the European Senior Manager of our Security Engineering team based in London.

 

What You'll Need to Thrive

  • Build and maintain core security products, including but not limited to Remote Access Management, Secrets Management, Tokenization, Encryption and Knowledge Graphs, Access Control at global scale.

  • Partner cross-functionally with Core Infrastructure, Product Engineering, Legal, Security teams and Vendor Partners to build "paved paths" that provide actionable feedback to embed secure design practices into the product and infrastructure development process.

  • Lead the technical direction and roadmap for your assigned area of ownership.

  • Build and maintain high Operational Excellence (OE) to ensure we operate T0 services with excellence, rigor and durable standards to ensure minimal to no downtime.

  • Participate in on-call rotation and promptly respond to on-call events with urgency and rigor.

  • Manage the lifecycle of security product feature requests and improvements full life-cycle from triage, validation, design, testing, and implementation.

  • Influence and drive improvements to engineering standards, leverage advancements and LLMs to improve productivity and velocity.

  • Mentor and coach earlier career engineers, setting and enforcing high standards for Operational Excellence and Software Engineering.

 

Requirements

  • Able to demonstrate a track record of driving improvements to a company's infrastructure security posture.

  • Breadth of technical experience across various infrastructure and security areas running in large production environments.

  • Highly skilled in distributed systems and platforms development using program languages such as Java/Scala/Kotlin, Golang, or Python.

  • Strong experience with infrastructure as a code tooling like Terraform.

  • Expertise with cloud infrastructure and management in AWS.

  • Experience solving complex, systemic issues that require creative thinking and solutions.

  • Exceptional analytical and investigative abilities with hands-on experience leading root cause analysis.

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills to review design documents with respect to cloud infrastructure, security and engineering personnel.

  • Must be comfortable regularly exercising discretion and independent judgment in performing job duties, including evaluating options, making informed decisions, and determining appropriate courses of action within the scope of assigned responsibilities with minimal oversight.

At Deliveroo, you'll do work that matters—solving real-world problems in a three-sided marketplace that's constantly evolving. 🌱 See your impact, ship fast, leaning into AI, test and improve ideas quickly in a low-hierarchy, high-ownership environment.

🧠 Grow through challenge and ownership. Take on big, ambiguous problems and accelerate your career with strong support.

🌎 A culture built for builders high standards, collaboration, flexible working and continuous learning.

💰 Share in the success you help create competitive salary and DoorDash RSUs, so you're rewarded for the impact you make.

Instead, you'll need enough technical depth across both areas to understand how they fit together, identify gaps and risks, challenge incomplete information and drive the right conversations to get a site successfully integrated.

Your role is to bring together three perspectives throughout onboarding:

Customer: What is the customer trying to achieve, and what do we need from them?

Product: How will the asset operate within KrakenFlex, and what product capabilities and configuration are required?

Engineering: How does the physical asset need to be integrated, connected and commissioned to make that solution work?

  • Own the end-to-end onboarding and delivery of Generation Flex assets BESS (grid-scale and C&I) and RES (Wind and Solar), from initial onboarding through analysis, site design, installation, configuration, commissioning, testing and handover into live service.

    • Electrical Single Line Diagrams (SLDs)

We raised a $250M Series C to build the search engine for AIs. Led by a16z, with existing investors Benchmark, Lightspeed, and YC doubling down, the round brings Exa's valuation to $2.2 billion.

Exa is building a search engine for the AI era. Our Search API currently powers Agents, Fortune 500s and AI labs as we transform an industry that hasn't been disrupted since the 90s. We're a largely SF-based team of ~100 from Harvard, MIT, Meta, Google Research, ex-founders & dropouts alike.

We are rapidly building the most intelligent search engine in history. We're high agency, low-ego, and united by the feeling that this is one of the last problems worth getting right.

We are looking for a Field Event Manager based in London to build our presence across EMEA.

About the Role

Exa is expanding to the EU and the UK and we are looking for an ambitious, proactive, and collaborative Field Marketer to partner closely with our regional team and build demand in this critical market. Companies big and small are making critical decisions about how to invest in AI and how their AI agents will retrieve information, and you will play a key role in how they discover Exa. As the first Field Marketer in EMEA, you will shape how buyers experience our brand and interact with our team, through highly strategic, and thoughtfully crafted events.

This is one of those rare, founding team member opportunities: you'll build the regional program from the ground up and inform so much beyond our event strategy; from messaging and overall brand presence at a pivotal time for Exa. This is an incredible fit for someone who sweats the details, lives to create world-class experiences, and obsesses over how to drive pipeline from every touchpoint. You will own the regional program, identify opportunities to build brand awareness and pipeline through a mix of high-hospitality and lead generating events including: executive dinners, networking receptions, hackathons, third-party sponsorships, partner events, and more. You'll partner strategically with Account Executives and SDRs to build an event plan that delivers coverage across your territory and key accounts.

Our bar is high and our north star is to establish Exa as a world-class brand. We’re a team that embraces learnings as opportunities to optimize future events and processes, while remaining focused on our pursuit to drive ever increasing pipeline. If this sounds exciting to you, we'd love to meet you!

This role is based in person in London, with regular travel across the EMEA and the occasional trip to our San Francisco HQ.

What You Will Own

Regional program strategy. Own the plan for your territory, deciding which formats, cities, audiences, and investments will meet our pipeline goals each quarter. Co-build the plan with input from sales and defend it with pipeline rationale. Success is measured by program quality and by pipeline sourced and influenced in the region.

End-to-end execution. Own every event from concept to post-event follow-up: sourcing venues, orchestrating vendors and production, managing invitations and the run of show, overseeing on-site execution, and sweating every detail. Success is measured by the number of qualified attendees and by nailing execution.

Sales partnership and account targeting alignment. Establish and maintain tight sales partnerships, align with sales to get the right personas and accounts to each event and create effective event playbooks that convert to pipeline. Success is measured by meetings generated and by the number of target accounts engaged through your programs.

Pipeline outcomes and follow-through. Own what happens during and after the event: ensuring timely lead handoff and building the follow-up sequence in partnership with SDRs, Lifecycle Marketing, and Marketing Ops. Success is measured by conversion from attendee to qualified opportunity.

Budget and vendors. Own your regional budget, vendor selection and negotiation, and cost per qualified lead. Success is measured by program impact per dollar.

AI-first operations. Use AI to compress operational timelines: invite-list development, personalized outreach at scale, vendor research, run-of-show generation, and post-event summarization. You'll run a serious regional program because the busywork is automated.

Who You Are

  • 4+ years of experience in field marketing or event marketing at a B2B technology company, including ownership of a regional program rather than execution of someone else's.

  • Deeply committed to event craft: You can walk us through a run of show, tell us what you check at 4pm before a 6pm start, and describe the last thing that went wrong at an event and how you fixed it.

  • Demonstrated ability to drive pipeline: You have owned a pipeline number and can speak to cost per qualified lead.

  • Evidence of strong sales partnership: You can speak to how you've built strong partnerships with sales counterparts in similar roles, including how you manage reps who push for something you know isn't the right investment.

  • Deep understanding of the EMEA market: You have a finger on the pulse of the cultural nuances, best venues, vendors, and event tactics that will draw an audience of senior technical buyers here.

  • Meticulous event budget and timeline management: You have both budget and vendor negotiation experience.

  • Upholds a growth mindset: You embrace feedback as a lever to fuel growth and see learnings as an opportunity to optimize for next time.

  • Experience using AI to drive efficiencies: You use AI daily to remove operational load, and can show us how.

Nice to Have

  • Experience running events for a technical or developer audience alongside enterprise buyers.

  • Experience at an early-stage company where you built the program rather than inherited it.

  • Experience developing booth designs and strategies that drive lead generation.

  • Familiarity with event tech (registration, badge scanning, on-site capture) and how it connects to CRM.

  • Experience crafting executive roundtables or advisory dinners for senior technical leaders.

  • Experience building reports to track event performance.

Benefits

  • Health and wellness: Premium medical coverage, plus a monthly wellness benefit tiered by location.

  • Fertility and family planning: Reimbursement for eligible egg freezing and related medical expenses up to a $15,000 lifetime maximum, plus 16 weeks of fully paid parental leave for all new parents, whether through birth, adoption, surrogacy, or foster placement.

  • Life at Exa: Our SF office serves lunch and dinner daily, with snacks, coffee, fresh bread from a local bakery, weekly milk tea, monthly picnics, and parties to celebrate the wins (and each other). You'll visit often.

  • Visa sponsorship: We sponsor visas for exceptional candidates and welcome applicants from all backgrounds and locations.

You will join our EMEA Commercial team, part of Elliptic's global Commercial organisation, and champion uncovering and developing new customer relationships across EMEA. As an Inside Sales Representative you will become an expert in Elliptic's value proposition, helping both prospective and existing customers navigate and enter the digital asset market with your knowledge of our product and of the compliance and regulatory environment.

You will own the full sales cycle for new business in the Growth segment, and you will grow the customers already in your patch in two ways: up-sell, expanding what an existing customer already buys as their usage and licence needs grow, and cross-sell, introducing Elliptic products they do not yet use. You will manage the full cycle including prospecting, qualifying, developing proposals, negotiating terms and closing.

This is an opportunity to build a career in a market you can shape as well as sell into. Fascinating and challenging work is the norm - working at Elliptic is never boring!

What you will do:

  • Run the full sales cycle, from pipeline generation to deal closure, across a territory with massive potential and that has considerable inbound interest.

  • Develop net new business and cross sell opportunities across the Growth segment within EMEA

  • Build out strategic market penetration plan, prospect, and manage full sales cycle

  • Use AI tooling to work a patch of 1,000+ Growth accounts at scale: researching and segmenting accounts, building and iterating outbound motions, and drafting personalised outreach at volume without losing quality.

  • Proactively contact prospects to identify & qualify sales opportunities.

  • Prospect and generate high quality leads

  • Develop custom proposals based on customer requirements

  • Conduct presentations and product demos

  • Negotiate terms and close the business

  • Work with Customer Success to review licence utilisation and product adoption across the accounts in your patch, using that data to identify and run up-sell and cross-sell plays, with ownership agreed per account with the CSM.

  • Be an ambassador of the Elliptic brand, living our values of curiosity, trust, and action in every interaction.

  • Own your number: meet and exceed quarterly and annual quota, keep an accurate and current forecast with all sales pipeline and activity managed in CRM, and drive linearity so revenue lands consistently through the quarter rather than in the closing weeks.

What you will achieve in the first 6 months:

  • Completed Elliptic's product certifications and onboarding processes.

  • Mapped your territory and built a qualified pipeline of at least 3x your quarterly quota through a combination of inbound, outbound, and partner-sourced opportunities.

  • Established a recurring utilisation review with your CSM counterpart covering your patch, with a standing list of up-sell and cross-sell plays ranked by adoption signal.

  • Run complete discovery cycles, using the Value Pyramid to connect client pain points to our solutions, applying MEDDPPICC to qualify or disqualify with confidence, and have a clear view of what you're walking away from and why.

  • Mapped and segmented your patch of 1,000+ accounts, and built qualified pipeline coverage of 3x your New Business quarterly target and 2x your Expansion quarterly target, through open opportunities sourced across inbound, outbound and partner routes.

  • Established a repeatable weekly rhythm that produces a consistent monthly close rate, closing new business every month rather than in end-of-quarter bursts, so that by the end of your first six months you are in a position to hit and exceed your quarterly target.

You will be a great fit here if you are:

  • A driven, tenacious “hunter” who thrives on owning their number and finding creative ways to meet and exceed it.

  • Experience in B2B SaaS and/or DaaS sales within RegTech, FinTech, and/or Crypto.

  • Commercially curious, you ask smart questions, seek to understand the "why" behind a customer’s problems, and use those insights to tailor impactful solutions.

  • Confident, consultative, and persuasive, able to build strong stakeholder relationships at all levels, from mid-level managers to C-suites.

  • A collaborative team player, independent yet never a “lone wolf.” You value and engage support from your pack.

  • Agile, resourceful, and fearless, you see opportunities where others see blockers and know how to create inroads where none appear to exist.

  • Can understand the customer’s business model, and how digital assets fit into their strategy

  • Have the ability to analyse data to identify market trends and opportunities for cryptocurrency and compliance

  • Can evaluate customer needs and preferences in relation to pricing, product terms and conditions to ensure that client requirements are addressed in commercial proposals

  • Enjoy working with pace and energy, building team spirit and cultivating unity and commitment among the team

  • Have an understanding of complex B2B sales methodologies

  • Are a self-starter, adaptable and comfortable with changing priorities

  • Proven experience and knowledge of use of AI tools into day-to-day workflows

Our ideal candidate has:

  • Strong outbound prospecting skills, with a track record of generating net new business and pipeline growth

  • Demonstrated track record of success and quota over achievement

  • A strong work ethic and an entrepreneur’s mindset. You’re comfortable creating value in a low structure environment while being agile and resilient

  • Minimum baseline understanding about digital assets and the crypto economy

  • Familiarity with the MEDDPPICC methodology and Value Based Selling.

  • Proficiency in CRM systems (HubSpot or similar), LLMs and other AI-driven prospecting and work efficiency tools.

  • Passionate about agentic AI and excited to help customers navigate a rapidly evolving industry.

Bonus Points for:

  • Intimate understanding of AML/KYC and Forensics space, either in cryptocurrency or traditional financial environments

  • Experience selling SaaS solutions to crypto-native financial services business

  • Fluency / business level in European language(s)

  • A proven use case and understanding of agentic AI is a strong plus.

How We Work

  • Hybrid working and the option to work from almost anywhere for up to 90 days per year

  • £500 Remote working budget to set up your home office space

Learning & Development:

  • £1,000 Learning & Development budget to use on anything (agreed with your manager) that contributes to your growth and development

Vacation/ Leave:

  • Holidays: 25 days of annual leave + bank holidays

  • An extra day for your birthday

  • Enhanced parental leave: we provide eligible employees, regardless of gender or whether they become a parent by birth or adoption, 16 weeks fully-paid leave and leave.

Benefits:

  • Private Health Insurance - we use Bupa!

  • Full access to Spill Mental Health Support

  • Life Assurance: we hope you will never need this - but our cover is for 4 times your salary to your beneficiaries

  • Cycle to Work Scheme

We know Diversity and Inclusion is much deeper than just hiring, but it’s important for us to mention it here. We welcome and embrace individuals of all backgrounds and identities at Elliptic, and this is an ongoing priority for us. We know incredible people don’t all think in the same way. We want to be challenged every day. We believe our diverse team of individuals underpins this by bringing creative thinking and innovation to Elliptic every day. We are committed to creating a diverse, inclusive and equitable workplace, so we welcome applications from everyone, even if you may not think you fit all of the requirements of our roles. We foster an environment of psychological safety, where everyone feels comfortable to bring their whole self to work.

Ultimately we are looking to hire those who want to be the future leaders in the industry, super intrigued by Crypto and have an awesome mindset to learn so if you don’t meet all the criteria still do apply!

Working as a Pharmacy dispenser supporting the supply of CMBP in a specialist Private pharmacy. This is a niche role in a growing area. The successful candidate will be working alongside specialist Clinical Pharmacists to make CMBP more accessible for all patients

This role with cover our evening shift starting at 12:00pm-9pm

Key responsibilities:

  • Receiving and validating prescriptions ready for a clinical check.

  • Processing patient information appropriately.

  • Supporting the Responsible Pharmacist & Technicians in the daily operations of the Pharmacist.

  • Maintaining relevant records for the supply of CMBP.

  • Maintaining stock and security of any CMBP on site.

  • Supporting governance in the Pharmacy to ensure the pharmacy is operating as safely as possible.

Qualifications, skills and experience:

  • A UK qualified Pharmacy dispenser

  • Ideally Undertaken CPD-accredited medical cannabis educational programme. Through this will be provided for the successful candidate

  • Self-motivated individual with high levels of attention to detail, able to work accurately, identifying errors quickly and easily

  • Experience in working in the pharmacy dispensary either primary and/or secondary environment

  • Has attention to detail, patience and the ability to remain calm during stressful situations

  • Excellence in communication skills with staff, patients and other healthcare professionals.

  • Professional, ethical and committed to providing excellent customer care

  • Excellent computer literacy with good working knowledge of office applications including Word, Excel and PowerPoint

What we offer:

  • Bupa Private Healthcare Scheme

  • 25 days holiday (rising to 27 after one year & 30 after 2 years) + bank holidays

  • 5% matched pension

  • Opportunities for development and growth

Montu UK is a leading digital health company specialising in cannabis-based medicines (CBPM). What is the job?

You will support our pharmacy operation at the Winnersh site. You are responsible for making sure every medicine that leaves our pharmacy is right. That means accuracy checking dispensed medicines, keeping standards high, and actively contributing to a culture where getting it right the first time is non-negotiable. You will not be managed through every task. You will be trusted to lead, to spot problems before they become incidents, and to raise the bar for everyone around you.

What will you be doing?

  • Carrying out accuracy checks on dispensed medicines, ensuring full compliance with legal, operational and safety standards

  • Taking ownership of the end-to-end dispensing process — not just your part of it

  • Maintaining clear, accurate prescription records and escalating discrepancies without hesitation

  • Actively mentoring junior colleagues and helping to build a team culture rooted in accountability, safety and quality

  • Staying sharp on professional development, best practice and regulatory changes — because you want to, not because you have to

  • Working with pace and purpose alongside the wider pharmacy team to ensure every patient gets exactly what they need, when they need it

What do you need?

  • Level 3 NVQ in Pharmacy Services (ACT) or equivalent ACT qualification

  • Current registration as a Pharmacy Technician with the GPhC — no exceptions

  • Solid, proven experience in a pharmacy setting with a strong track record in accuracy checking

  • Deep working knowledge of pharmacy regulations, policies and SOPs

  • The kind of attention to detail that you simply cannot switch off

What do you get?

  • Hourly rate of £16 to £18

  • Shifts are 8 hours per day with a 30 minute unpaid break

  • Shifts start times from 7am to 10am

  • Monday to Saturday

Our mission is to transform lives by combining innovative technology with high-quality clinical care, ensuring patients receive the support they need at every step of their journey.

As a fast-growing organisation, we offer a collaborative and supportive environment where talented people can develop their careers while contributing to meaningful change in healthcare. At Montu UK, your work has a direct impact on improving patients’ lives and expanding access to modern medical treatments.

source_record.description:
About the Role

 

You'll lead clinical and regulatory operations at Montu Pharmacy – the dispensing engine behind the UK's largest medical cannabis clinic. We're processing 50,000 prescriptions monthly with 10% month-on-month growth. This isn't a traditional pharmacy role.

 

You'll own:

• Clinical governance and professional leadership for a digital-first, high-volume operation

• GPhC and regulatory compliance across all pharmacy operations

• Controlled Drugs governance and record-keeping at scale

• Team leadership and clinical competency for 100+ pharmacy staff

• Pharmacy systems, SOPs, and automation strategy

• Regulatory inspections, audits, and industry representation

Your scope is real. You'll shape pharmacy strategy alongside the Medical Director and General Manager. You'll evaluate new services, lead regulatory readiness for expansion, and influence technology investments. You won't be managing a counter or chasing rotas – you'll be building the future of digital pharmacy.

 

Who we're looking for

 

You've either:

• Worked as a Superintendent Pharmacist in a high-volume, fast-paced environment

• Led clinical teams in a scale-up, healthtech, or innovative healthcare setting

• Worked where the rulebook was still being written (and thrived in it)

You are:

• Registered with GPhC, with strong knowledge of current GPhC Standards and MHRA regulations

• Experienced in Controlled Drugs governance and regulatory compliance

• Comfortable with automation, pharmacy technology, and operational efficiency

• A calm decision-maker who can hold rigorous standards whilst navigating growth and complexity

• Commercially aware – you understand KPIs and how pharmacy operations drive business

• Able to influence across clinical and non-clinical teams

• Genuinely interested in healthcare innovation

This is not for you if: you're looking for a predictable, quiet pharmacy role in a traditional setting. The pace is real. The expectations are high. You'll need to act decisively without waiting for everything to be settled first.

 

Experience Required

 

Essential:

• Current GPhC registration as a Pharmacist

• Experience as a Superintendent Pharmacist or senior pharmacy leader

• Deep understanding of GPhC Standards for Pharmacy Professionals

• MHRA regulations knowledge (importing, wholesaling, storage standards)

• Experience managing Controlled Drugs governance and regulation compliance

• Track record leading teams in high-volume pharmacy

• Experience with regulatory inspections and audit readiness

Desirable (but valuable):

• Online pharmacy or digital health experience

• Medical cannabis or private healthcare sector experience

• Multi-site pharmacy or scaling operations experience

• Pharmacy technology, automation, or systems implementation experience

 

What success looks like

 

Within your first year:

• You've earned trust with the clinical and operations teams

• Pharmacy governance frameworks are documented, audited, and fit for purpose

• Team competencies are assessed, trained, and maintained to GPhC standards

• Controlled Drugs governance is robust, auditable, and scalable for growth

• You've led the pharmacy through a successful regulatory inspection or audit

• You've identified and influenced implementation of key technology or automation improvements

• You're actively shaping the pharmacy's clinical and regulatory strategy

 

What you'll be doing

 

Daily:

• Provide clinical leadership and ensure patient-centred governance

• Oversee pharmacy operations, staff competencies, and SOPs

• Maintain GPhC and MHRA compliance across all areas

• Manage Controlled Drugs records and governance

• Monitor medicines expenditure and suggest scalable improvements

• Support the team to maintain accuracy and pace simultaneously

Strategic:

• Shape clinical and governance strategy alongside senior leadership

• Evaluate new services and products for regulatory feasibility

• Lead regulatory readiness for business expansion

• Represent Montu with regulators and industry bodies

• Influence pharmacy technology and automation investments

• Support business growth through scalable governance frameworks

 

The Scope

 

You'll be responsible for:

• 50,000+ prescriptions per month (and growing 10% monthly)

• Millions of pounds of medicines under management annually

• Clinical oversight of a 100+ person pharmacy team

• Compliance across GPhC, MHRA, and all statutory regulations

• Controlled Drugs governance and audit

• Pharmacy systems and SOP governance

• Regulatory inspections and audit preparation

• Collaboration with clinical, operations, technology, and commercial teams

 

What we offer:

The salary range is £100,000 to £110,000 depending on experience, with a 25% performance-related bonus. Alongside that:

Benefits include:

• 25 days holiday, rising to 27 after year one and 30 after year three, plus 8 bank holidays

• Pension matching up to 5% employer contributions

• Private healthcare scheme

• Enhanced maternity and paternity leave

• Cycle-to-work and EV scheme

• Genuine growth: collaboration across teams, representation at industry events, and direct involvement in shaping a scaling business

 

About Montu

Montu UK is the leading digital health company specialising in cannabis-based medicines, dedicated to improving patient access to safe and effective treatments. Our mission is to transform lives by combining innovative technology with high-quality clinical care, ensuring patients receive the support they need at every step of their journey.

 

As a fast-growing organisation, we offer a collaborative environment where talented people develop their careers whilst contributing to meaningful change in healthcare. Your work here has a direct impact on patients' lives and on expanding access to modern medical treatments.

 

Compensation: £100K – £110K • Offers Bonus

We are hiring to enhance our Security and Compliance efforts. In this role, you will work closely with Security Compliance, Senior Leadership, and Site Reliability Engineering to support our GRC initiatives.

We provide a low-latency, high-throughput distributed messaging system to the e-trading Fixed-income markets. We are, foremost, a technology service provider and support for part of our customers’ trading infrastructure.

  • Experience answering complex compliance questionnaires, ideally from Banks or highly regulated organisations

  • Experience in developing and implementing information security policies, standards and procedures

  • Experience leading ISO27001 and SOC 2 certification processes

  • Familiarity with standards and frameworks such as ISO 27001, SOC 2, NIST CSF, as well as legal frameworks such as DORA, NIS2, and GDPR

  • Have experience working with Vanta or similar GRC automation tools

  • Can comprehend penetration test and vulnerability scan results

  • Have startup experience or experience working in a fast-moving environment

  • Are comfortable using technical tools, CLIs, or basic scripting to improve compliance workflows

Fleetcraft builds the critical infrastructure for the next generation of aircraft.

Aerospace is in a once-in-a-lifetime transformation. OEMs have decade-long backlogs, new manufacturers are racing to market, and demand for spaceflight is surging. Meanwhile the industry is hundreds of thousands of technicians short, and the systems used to maintain and manufacture aircraft are slow, manual, and largely unchanged in decades.

We're building the systems that work alongside technicians, understand the aircraft, and keep the hangar moving.

Our team has helped launch airlines and put satellites into orbit. Our aviation advisory board has run major aircraft OEMs, led airworthiness at Gulfstream, and overseen training facilities that educate a quarter of all aircraft mechanics in the US.

Susa Ventures led our seed alongside Liquid 2 VC, early backers of Anduril and Stoke Space. We've raised a $5.3M seed round and are on track for our Series A.

What you'll do

You'll build and scale the core systems aircraft technicians use every day: deciding the architecture, writing the code, and sitting in the hangar watching people use it.

  • Build and scale the core systems that aircraft MROs rely on every day.

  • Build AI agent systems end-to-end, from voice interfaces on the hangar floor to workflow orchestration across maintenance operations.

  • Own projects from architecture to deployment, with autonomy over technical decisions.

  • Own reliability: infrastructure, observability, and evals for AI in a regulated industry.

  • Turn aerospace data into trusted pipelines, from maintenance manuals and work orders to airworthiness directives and parts catalogues.

  • Stay at the frontier by adopting new model capabilities and improving the team's tooling.

  • Talk to technicians, maintenance managers, and regulators, then turn what you learn into product decisions.

What you'll need

  • 3+ years of full-stack experience.

  • Ability to build high-quality software fast.

  • A co-owner mindset. We'll give you the customer context and the autonomy to find the best path forward, and expect you to own the outcome.

  • You learn fast. Aerospace experience isn't required.

  • You're pragmatic and structured.

Strong plus: Early-stage experience, competitive programming, trading, building agents.

Tech stack: FastAPI · Pydantic · TypeScript · React · OpenAI / Anthropic · PostgreSQL · Turbopuffer · Promptfoo · Azure

What we offer

£100k–£130k salary plus meaningful early-stage equity.
Modern tools, real-world impact in a regulated industry, and the chance to define how AI transforms aerospace from the ground up.

We are a small, high-trust team where your decisions move the whole company forward. If you're energised by building production AI systems that solve hard, real-world problems - and you want the ownership and pace that only comes from being early at something important, we'd love to talk.


We're unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role.
Fleetcraft is an equal opportunities employer.

source_record.description:
Do you ever have the urge to do things better than the last time? We do. And it’s this urge that drives us every day. Our environment of discovery and innovation means we’re able to create deep and valuable relationships with our clients to create real change for them and their industries. It’s what got us here – and it’s what will make our future. At Quantexa, you’ll experience autonomy and support in equal measures allowing you to form a career that matches your ambitions. 41% of our colleagues come from an ethnic or religious minority background. We speak over 20 languages across our 47 nationalities, creating a sense of belonging for all.

We're heading in one direction, the future. We’d love you to join us.

This role can be based in either the London, New York, or Boston.

The Opportunity.

We are seeking a Global Head of Fraud Solutions, a visionary and commercially minded leader to define, scale, and evolve Quantexa’s Fraud and Security solutions globally across all major industries.

As an integral member of our core Product Leadership Team, you will chart an ambitious path forward for Quantexa's counter-fraud suite. You will serve as a respected global thought leader, representing Quantexa at major international conferences, in front of analysts, and with senior executives at top-tier institutions

You will own the global solution strategy, shape the product roadmap, and work closely with R&D, Marketing, Sales, Alliances, and TAP teams to deliver market-leading capabilities.

The role includes leadership of a high-performing, geographically distributed team of regional Solution Owners and fraud SMEs (covering EMEA, APAC, and North America).

It successfully combines high-level strategic influence with a hands-on approach, requiring you to act as a bi-lateral individual contributor when leading key global customer pursuits

What you'll be doing:

Solution Strategy & Market Leadership

  • Global Strategy Ownership: Define and drive the global strategy, vision, and roadmap for Quantexa's Fraud Solutions.

  • Roadmap Steering: Translate global market requirements, technological shifts, and regulatory trends into specific product roadmap features in partnership with Product Management and, by extension, our Engineering team.

  • Industry Eminence: Produce high-impact thought leadership (whitepapers, blogs, webinars), serve as a recognized global authority and keynote speaker at premier industry events (e.g., SIBOS, ACAMS, and global fraud forums), and proactively engage with relevant Analyst Firms and lead domain analysts.

  • Competitive Intelligence: Maintain deep currency of the global competitor landscape and ensure our value propositions are uniquely differentiated and our battlecards are compelling.

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Subject Matter Authority: Act as the central SME on counter-fraud solutions, guiding, shaping, and credentialing product positioning for our Sales and Field Engineering/Customer Success teams.

  • Value-Driven Narratives: Collaborate with Product Marketing to design scalable, industry-specific solution narratives that align with enterprise business value and target senior buyers.

  • Work closely with our Delivery (professional services) team as subject-matter advisor on critical domain questions and issues during deployment of Fraud solutions.

  • Go-To-Market Execution & Growth:

  • Global GTM Plans: support the creation, refinement and execution of global Go-to-Market plans for Fraud Solutions, collaborating with regional sales heads to meet overall ARR and growth targets

  • Strategic Pursuit Support: Partner with regional Sales leaders on strategic global accounts, helping shape, position, and differentiate our fraud solutions during key client workshops.

  • Ecosystem Co-Innovation: Work with the Global Alliances team to identify, stand up, and nurture strategic relationships and related joint offerings with key partners (e.g., cloud hyperscalers, global consultancies, and system integrators)

  • Strategic PoC/PoV: Strategically support and contribute to the execution of high-profile global Proof of Concepts (PoCs) and Proof of Values (PoVs), ensuring we clearly prove business outcomes and "move the needle" for clients.

Team Leadership

  • Global Fraud Team Development: Lead, coach, and develop a diverse, global team of Solution Owners and regional Fraud heads across EMEA, APAC, and North America

  • Culture of Innovation: Foster a culture of technical excellence, continuous learning, and cross-regional collaboration

  • Broader Product Leadership: Serve as a strong contributing member of the core Product Leadership Team, living our values of Determination, Ambition, Teamwork and Accountability every day.

What you’ll bring:

  • Deep SME Background: Extensive experience of direct counter-fraud risk management, compliance, or investigation experience within financial services, government, professional services, or consulting.

  • Global Product & Solution Leadership: Proven track record of leading product strategy, solution ownership, or software development within an enterprise software vendor - specifically directing the growth and evolution of complex multi-industry fraud platforms - including a deep understanding of how AI is shaping counter fraud solutions.

  • Global Executive Presence: Strong executive presence with a proven ability to influence, engage, and build trust with C-suite stakeholders at major global banks, insurers, and government agencies.

  • Matrix Operations: Experience operating within a fast-paced, matrixed software product environment, collaborating seamlessly across sales, alliances, marketing, and R&D

  • Technical Acumen: Deep curiosity and technical comprehension of data-driven, analytical solutions such as Entity Resolution, Graph/Network Analytics, AI/ML models, and Big Data platforms

  • People Management: A track record of successfully managing, mentoring, and developing high-performing, geographically distributed teams

  • Flexibility: Willingness to travel internationally (~30%) to support strategic customer engagements and partner enablement

Our perks and quirks.

What makes you Q will help you to realize your full potential, flourish and enjoy what you do, while being recognized and rewarded with our broad range of benefits.

We offer:

  • Competitive salary & Company bonus

  • 25 days annual leave (with the option of buying up to 5 days, and rolling over up to 10), plus national holidays + your birthday off!

  • Pension scheme with a company contribution of 6% (when you contribute 3%)

  • Private Healthcare, including dental & optic cover

  • Life Insurance and Income Protection

  • Regularly bench-marked salary rates

  • Enhanced Maternity, Paternity, Adoption, or Shared Parental Leave

  • Well-being days

  • Volunteer Day off

  • Work from Home Equipment

  • Commuter, Tech and cycle to work schemes

  • Free Subscription to a meditation, relaxation and sleep app

  • Continuous Training and Development

  • Spend up to 2 months working outside of your country of employment over a rolling 12-month period with our ‘Work from Anywhere’ policy

  • Team Social Budget & Company-wide Socials

Our mission.

We have one mission. To help businesses grow. To make data easier. And to make the world a better place. We’re not a start-up. Not anymore. But we’ve not been around that long either. What we are is a collection of bright, passionate minds harnessing complexities and helping our clients and their communities. One culture, made of many. Heading in one direction – the future.

It’s all about you.

We want you to feel welcome, valued, and respected - because it’s your individuality and passion that make you Q. We see that, and we celebrate it. That’s why we’re proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer.

We are committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse work environment, continuously improving to ensure everyone belongs. Our recruitment process is designed to be inclusive and accessible. If you need any reasonable adjustments or accommodations, please let our Talent Acquisition Team know - we’re happy to assist.

No matter your race, beliefs, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, neurodiversity, or abilities—whoever you are—if you're a passionate, curious, and caring human eager to push the boundaries of what’s possible, we want to hear from you.
